standard: Every action benefiting a named private party (contracts, purchases, renewals, change orders, piggybacks, zoning/land use/variances/plats/site plans/development agreements, leases and sales of public land, grants and fee waivers to named organizations, settlements, easements, licenses). Excludes proclamations, ceremonial items, appointments, internal staffing, government-only items. Built without reference to donors.

gaps.issue: Tenure extension (Oct 25, 2026): Vazquez and Sardinas were installed Nov 17, 2022. Granicus posts minutes for 30 of the 41 council meetings from Nov 29, 2022 to Dec 17, 2024 (the Nov 29 and Dec 13, 2022 minutes are scans, read by OCR). No minutes posted for: Jan 17, Feb 15 (regular), Mar 14, Sep 12, Sep 26 (budget and special) 2023; Jun 25, Sep 10, Sep 24, Oct 22, Oct 23 2024. Private-party items from those agendas are listed with roll null.
